List-II (Regions)
(A) Banawali
(I) Haryana
(B) Dholavira
(II) Gujarat
(C) Shortughai (III) Rajasthan
(D) Kalibangan (IV) Afghanistan
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

Match: (A)-(I), (B)-(II), (C)-(IV), (D)-(III).
